startUrls.title: Search URLs (batch)
startUrls.description: One or more vivanuncios.com.mx list pages. Prefer verified location-id URLs (…/v1c…l…p1).

urls.title: Search URLs (store-compat alias)
urls.description: Alias for startUrls — same shape as stealth_mode/vivanuncios-property-search-scraper.

startUrl.title: Single search URL (legacy)
startUrl.description: Single list URL when not using startUrls/urls

maxItems.title: Max listings (total)
maxItems.description: Hard cap across all URLs (default: maxItemsPerUrl × URL count)

maxItemsPerUrl.title: Max listings per URL
maxItemsPerUrl.description: Cap per search URL across its pages

max_items_per_url.title: Max listings per URL (snake_case alias)
max_items_per_url.description: Alias for maxItemsPerUrl — same as stealth_mode store actor field

ignore_url_failures.title: Ignore URL failures
ignore_url_failures.description: Continue other URLs when one SERP fails

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify residential MX proxy — required (Cloudflare blocks datacenter IPs)
